channel.title: 3 Steps Ahead · News & updates
channel.description: What is new in 3 Steps Ahead, the free MTG Arena companion: every update explained, from the Leak Finder and the replayer to the Deck HUD and shared games.

item.title: What equity means in Magic, step by step
item.description: Your chance to win, right now: what it is, where the number comes from, and how to answer a real question with it: cast the creature into open mana?

item.title: The EV engine, now in the replayer
item.description: Total victory points split like the engine, the hand you kept against your deck, the opponent's hand range in Limited, your lines under pressure.

item.title: Your games or your deck: the Leak Finder in 0.1.128
item.description: Player folders or deck folders, Habits judged in EV, Cards rows by category with Weakest first, and every limited event of the game.

item.title: Two second opinions on every choice
item.description: The engine behind the Leak Finder now reads every card. Under your attacks and blocks: the best line a search found, and how strong players handle the same spot.

item.title: Tune a Constructed deck: what to cut, what to add
item.description: Step by step on a real Standard deck: the matchups it loses, the cards that carry it, a suspect card under the lens, and the answers to craft.

item.title: Why the Leak Finder thinks in EV
item.description: What EV is, why we stopped calling plays mistakes, and how the Leak Finder reasons from your side of the table.

item.title: Find where your Limited deck gains and loses EV
item.description: Step by step on a real draft deck: the games with the biggest EV swings, the opponent's side, the key moment, and how to find similar spots.

item.title: Leak Finder: expected against actual EV
item.description: EV vs expected on the chart, by turn and phase; what each card and each deed is worth; from a spot to what came next.

item.title: Building the tracker in the open: join and help
item.description: Every tab of the app, what is still unfinished, and how you can help build it: share your games, test it, join the Discord.

item.title: Leak Finder: ask about the table
item.description: A Board tab in Advanced filters, spell roles before or after combat, replays that open on your spot, and Filters from here.

item.title: The replayer, rebuilt action by action
item.description: One action at a time on a play mat: the stack, combat duels, mana, emblems, and every sequence checked against the log and the rules.

item.title: Meet the Leak Finder
item.description: Performance becomes the Leak Finder: the mistakes that cost you games, ranked by what they cost, with the replay on each one.

item.title: Shared games are live
item.description: Data sharing reaches our server, in the EU only. What is sent, what never is, and why it matters for the Meta tab.

item.title: Deck HUD: both decks on the edges of Arena
item.description: Your deck on the left edge with the odds of the next draw, the opponent's likely deck on the right. Decks, never players.

item.title: 3 Steps Ahead is out: free, in open beta
item.description: A free desktop companion for MTG Arena that reads your own log. What it does, what it never does, and how updates reach you.
